recipe.outcome: Turn a supported API description into a connector candidate and deploy a dedicated runtime for authorized use.
prerequisites: An authorized operator and an installed Connector Builder extension
A supported API description and runtime resources
configuration: Connector Builder is an optional extension, not an out-of-box core application.
Target-service credentials and runtime capacity are deployment-specific.
recipe.custom_app_boundary: The Connector Builder extension supplies this flow. A customer-specific API or app still needs its own integration and validation.
limits: The historical workbook links an Analyst journey to this extension, while the capability record names Operator and SysAdmin roles; Analyst self-service is unproven.
The 1.3.2 API scenario passed import, test and generation, but deployment timed out; it does not establish the end-to-end stream.
No Kaizen UI clickstream for these steps is recorded; API observations do not establish UI behavior.
The receipt is from a 1.3.2 local build, not a release verification for the 1.3.0 source scope.
The runnable API example stops before deployment. It has not been executed as a new live acceptance run for this recipe.

steps.action: Import an OpenAPI description into a connector project.

api.example: POST /api/projects/from-import with a supported OpenAPI document and a project name. Runnable import/test/generate source: /examples/connector-builder-import-test-generate.py.

instructions: No observed Kaizen UI clickstream establishes this step.

steps.expected_result: A project definition contains the imported operations.
steps.historical_observation: 1.3.2 local component: passed. No release binding or whole-stream credit.

steps.action: Test the imported definition and inspect endpoint mappings.

api.example: POST /api/projects/{project_id}/test after obtaining the project id from import.

instructions: No observed Kaizen UI clickstream establishes this step.

steps.expected_result: Per-endpoint test results show a policy decision and mapped records.
steps.historical_observation: 1.3.2 local component: passed. No release binding or whole-stream credit.

steps.action: Generate the tool package from the tested project.

api.example: POST /api/projects/{project_id}/generate; inspect the returned artifact list.

instructions: No observed Kaizen UI clickstream establishes this step.

steps.expected_result: Generated artifacts name the imported operations.
steps.historical_observation: 1.3.2 local component: passed. No release binding or whole-stream credit.

steps.action: Deploy the generated connector runtime and confirm it becomes active.

api.example: POST /api/projects/{project_id}/deploy; confirm active status and a runtime URL before use.

instructions: No observed Kaizen UI clickstream establishes this step.

steps.expected_result: An active runtime and deployment identifier are returned; the recorded attempt timed out.
steps.historical_observation: 1.3.2 local component: failed. No release binding or whole-stream credit.
